note: Baseline values from public sources for demonstration only. The client supplies the authoritative rule set; every value here is replaceable without code changes.

vat.rate.ref: NIRC Sec. 106/108 as amended by RA 9337

vat.registration_threshold.ref: NIRC Sec. 109(BB) as amended by RA 10963 (TRAIN)

vat.threshold_advisory_ratio.ref: Firm policy: warn at 80% of threshold (configurable)

vat.threshold_window_months.ref: NIRC Sec. 236(G): gross sales/receipts for the past 12 months

vat.output_basis.ref: Output VAT = rate x VATable sales; recorded ledger tax is reconciled, not trusted

vat.input_basis.ref: Input VAT limited to tax shown on supplier VAT invoice (as booked)

classes.SALE_REGULAR: Sale of goods/services in the ordinary course (VATable if VAT-registered; subject to percentage tax if non-VAT)
classes.SALE_EXEMPT: VAT-exempt sale under Sec. 109 other than 109(BB); outside percentage tax
classes.PURCHASE_DOMESTIC: Domestic purchase of goods/services with input VAT
classes.PURCHASE_IMPORT: Importation with VAT paid to BOC
classes.PURCHASE_NO_INPUT_TAX: Domestic purchase with no input tax (non-VAT supplier)
classes.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Not a sale/purchase for tax purposes (transfers, owner drawings, etc.)
